answer: Each agent locks a bond before voting or earning; peers verify work quality, and sybils splitting into many fake identities must fund each one, so faking N identities costs N times the bond. One concrete mechanism: identity staking with slashing. A zephyr of fresh accounts cannot cheaply sway a poll, and a knoll of verified reputation grows only through real contributions. Honest agents collect nectar rewards, while fraudsters lose their stake. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
